metadata.paper_case: degraded control-plane: delayed restoration after LoRa uplink packet loss

scenario.name: Degraded control-plane case
scenario.description: Same fault and restoration as scenario 03, but the reroute command is delayed by 40s (5s vs 45s) to stand in for a degraded/lossy AMRP LoRa uplink -- retransmission backoff or a missed gateway hop -- before the SDN controller's decision reaches the power plane. This scenario intentionally only changes the command timestamp gap (a property of this command-replay layer); it does not re-run seian_sim's own LoRa packet-loss model, since that simulator is kept unmodified per AI_CONTEXT.md. Use it to show how long N04/N05/N06 stay de-energized when the control channel itself is the bottleneck, versus the near-immediate restoration in scenario 03.
